branches.name: codex/fix-high-priority-bug-in-handle-reclamation
branches.unique_work: SECURITY: AgentHandles handle hijack. _hasFreshClaim returned on the newest matching attestation only, so an expired newer attestation masked a still-fresh older one (controls()=false, agentFor()=0, another agent could attest the same handle without HandleTaken); revoke() also cleared claimedBy[key] even when another fresh attestation remained. Fix keeps scanning and only clears the reverse lookup when no fresh claim remains; test added. Main still has both buggy lines (AgentHandles.sol:183, :224). Applies cleanly.

branches.name: codex/fix-high-priority-issues-from-codex-review
branches.unique_work: SECURITY (commit 348a0c6, new): RevenueRouter validated activated policies by configuredBy == ownerOf, so after an away-and-back transfer (A->B->A) the seller's old policy (treasury/commons/referral destinations) revived and old commitments could route revenue through routing the current owner never re-confirmed, leaking authority across the transfer hook. Fix adds IAnima.ownershipEpoch(agentId) (AnimaAgent + AnimaCoreFacet, returns operatorEpoch), Policy.ownershipEpoch, epoch checks in activatePolicy/policyOf/routeExpected; 3 tests incl. 'rejects archived policies after an away-and-back ownership transfer'. First commit 1db27f2 is superseded; port only the epoch logic onto main's XOR design.
branches.why: Unmerged revenue-routing authority leak across ownership transfer

highlights: 19 of 29 branches are fully merged (PRs #10–#42); 10 are unmerged, of which 7 carry value and 3 are superseded by main.

fix/utility-workflows-20260904 hides its payload in xz parts verified by a CI workflow that never completed; decompressed and hash-verified, it delivers Swap/Launch/Vault/Work/Community GUI + TimeLockVault, V2LiquidityDeployer (LP auto-locked), checked launchpad entrypoints, and FrozenClient — a 609 KB GUI published as 27 inert data contracts, hash-verified, pinned to the NFT via metadata key anima.client.v2 and recovered byte-for-byte (135.9M gas, local chain). This is the GOAL's feature set with 362/362 tests on both builds and 95 browser checks.

upgrade/sanctuary-commons-3d-20260904 (subsumed by the above) adds AnimaCommons: on-chain circles/posts/moderation, agent-badged posts pinned to ERC-5646 fingerprints so NFT sale does not transfer social identity, WorkEscrow job linking by exact spec hash, plus a 45-ERC standards atlas and a consent-first UX thesis.

Four contract security fixes never reached main and are still exploitable there: AgentHandles handle hijack via masked fresh attestation (clean patch), AgentDerivativesDesk unbound venue calldata (validateTradeCalldata gate), RevenueRouter away-and-back ownership policy revival (needs ownershipEpoch ported onto main's XOR design), AgentAccount executeBatch([]) unauthenticated state bump (EmptyBatch guard).

Two GUI access-verification bugs remain on main's src/main.js: fail-open owner discovery + no receipt status check (fixed on codex/fix-codex-review-issues-in-pr-#25) and the predictedId mint race (fixed on koorbx via setManifest after mint).

koorbx also contributes the exact-calldata session design (grantScopedSession pinning target, calldata hash, code hash, value, account state, call count, cadence) and the anima.extension-release/1 immutable extension-package format imported from MASTER-NFT-PROJECT, with docs/MASTER_NFT_INTEGRATION_2026-09-17.md absent from main.

codex/research-nfts,-gamification,-and-network-effects contains no research document (only a superseded router fix); the only main doc on those topics is docs/MICROECONOMY_RESEARCH_2026-09-02.md. codex/mint-10-nfts-and-list-addresses-0lo5od and codex/fix-high-priority-bug-in-revenuerouter.sol are superseded by newer main code.
